description: This PHP class defines an event controller for manufacturer-related events in the OpenCart admin system. It manages tasks such as adding, editing, and deleting manufacturers, and ensures that related data like manufacturer info and associated products are queued for updates via background tasks.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: An event handler class in the Opencart admin module responsible for queuing background tasks related to manufacturer data modifications (add, edit, delete).

methods.name: addManufacturer
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a manufacturer is added, queuing tasks to update manufacturer list and info.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a manufacturer is edited, queuing tasks for manufacturer info and associated products.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a manufacturer is deleted, queuing tasks for manufacturer removal and associated product updates.
